title: PR #51: governance: enforce evidence and preserve release diagnostics
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

## Governance enforcement implementation

This PR turns the governance baseline into repository/CI controls without weakening existing gates.

### Implemented

- Adds `docs/governance/GOVERNANCE-ENFORCEMENT-BASELINE-2026-09-24.md`.
- Adds `SCR-0129` for the Governance-100 assessment path.
- Adds deterministic `components/atc-standards/tools/governance_assessment.py`.
- Implements hard Phase-1 checks G01-G07:
  - registry integrity and version binding
  - lifecycle data integrity
  - standard metadata completeness
  - approval evidence
  - evidence-root structure
  - change-control data integrity
  - repository traceability
- Adds a Release Readiness CI gate that runs G01-G07 with `--strict`.
- Publishes machine-readable Governance-100 Phase-1 evidence as a CI artifact.
- Preserves complete Rust gate logs as CI artifacts for audit/root-cause analysis.

### Explicitly not claimed yet

G08-G16 are reported as non-PASS until their actual implementation/evidence exists. No missing control is converted into PASS.

The eventual 100/100 condition remains:

`G01..G16 = PASS` + no unapproved open governance findings.

### Existing gates

- No Rust format/check/test/clippy gate was weakened.
- No compiler error was suppressed.
- No ShivaCore source was modified.
- No governance rule was silently relaxed.

### Next verification

Release Readiness CI must now execute the new G01-G07 gate. Any failure is treated as a real repository inconsistency and fixed at the source.
